title: ARSIA Breach Notification
description: Validates the payload data for a GDPR breach notification event message (ARSIA-State.md §5.7). Carries structured breach information between agents for supervisory authority notification (Art. 33) or data subject notification (Art. 34). The notification_target discriminator selects the notification type; OPTIONAL fields carry SHOULD-level guidance in descriptions rather than structural enforcement.

notification_target.description: Discriminator for the notification type. 'supervisory_authority' for controller-to-DPA notifications per Art. 33; 'data_subject' for controller-to-data-subject notifications per Art. 34. Per ARSIA-State.md §5.7.

breach_id.description: Unique identifier for this breach. All notifications about the same breach share the same breach_id, enabling correlation of initial notifications and subsequent updates per Art. 33(4). Per ARSIA-State.md §5.7.

nature_of_breach.description: Description of the nature of the personal data breach including, where possible, the categories and approximate number of data subjects and records concerned. Per Art. 33(3)(a).

awareness_timestamp.description: When the controller became aware of the breach. Art. 33 requires notification within 72 hours of this timestamp. Per ARSIA-State.md §5.7.

categories_of_data.description: Categories of personal data affected (e.g., names, financial data, health records). SHOULD be present for supervisory_authority notifications. Per Art. 33(3)(a).

categories_of_data_subjects.description: Categories of data subjects affected (e.g., employees, customers, patients). SHOULD be present for supervisory_authority notifications. Per Art. 33(3)(a).

approximate_data_subject_count.description: Approximate number of data subjects affected. SHOULD be present for supervisory_authority notifications. Per Art. 33(3)(a).

approximate_record_count.description: Approximate number of personal data records affected. SHOULD be present for supervisory_authority notifications. Per Art. 33(3)(a).

likely_consequences.description: Description of the likely consequences of the breach. Per Art. 33(3)(b) and Art. 34(2).

measures_taken.description: Description of the measures taken or proposed to address the breach, including measures to mitigate possible adverse effects. Per Art. 33(3)(c)/(d) and Art. 34(2).

dpo_contact.description: Name and contact details of the data protection officer or other contact point. SHOULD be present for supervisory_authority notifications. Per Art. 33(3)(b).

remediation_advice.description: Advice to data subjects on steps they can take to protect themselves. SHOULD be present for data_subject notifications. Per Art. 34(2).
